cohort: The study included 350 patients who underwent surgical treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at Imam Khomeini Hospital in Ahvaz, Iran.
finding: Higher gestational age, specific uterine scarring patterns, and fetal status were significantly associated with increased maternal complications such as packed cell transfusion, hypervascularity, curettage, and laparotomy in CSP surgery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from medical records between 2014 and 2023.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 49.58 ± 17.07 days.
